spans.s:
Dabhīti appears several times in the Rigveda as a hero or
sage. Indra overcomes on his behalf Cumuri and Dhuni;^1
[]
he pressed Soma for Indra,^2 who rewarded him.^3 For him
30,000 Dāsas were sent to sleep,^4 and for him the Dasyus were
bound without cords.^5 Dabhīti also appears, with Turvīti, as
a protégé of the Aśvins.^6 There seems no reason to deny that
he was a real person.^7
1) x. 113, 9; ii. 15, 9; vii. 19, 4.
2) vi. 20, 13.
3) vi. 26, 6.
4) iv. 30, 21.
5) ii. 13, 9.
6) i. 112, 23.
7) Oldenberg, Religion des Veda, 155,
157, 158.
Cf. Macdonell, Vedic Mythology,
p. 162.
